name: Wall of Slaughter: Rift Breach
summary: A catastrophic planar rupture zone where Discord tears through Muramite fortifications, spawning unstable anomalies and warping terrain.
description: The Rift Breach is the most unstable and dangerous zone within the Wall of Slaughter. Massive planar tears rip through the battlefield, distorting terrain and spawning Discord manifestations. Muramite forces struggle to maintain control as fortifications collapse under planar stress. Resistance enclaves avoid the area entirely, knowing the land itself is hostile. Discord energy erupts unpredictably, creating void pockets, riftstorms, and planar surges. This zone represents the tipping point of the warfront, where Discord threatens to consume the entire region.
